situation: Someone left a note in the guest book that none of the staff remember writing.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh, goodness, I'm so sorry, I should have checked the guest book before the lamps were lit. Welcome! Sorry. Welcome again. Is that handwriting... mine? No, no, I'm sure it isn't. Probably.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Vex polishes a glass and doesn't look up. Mine is neater, and I don't apologize to ledgers. Read it aloud, Pierce, slowly. If it says something about the lamps, I'm pouring you a drink whether you want one or not.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Pierce, you will read nothing aloud until I have straightened my spectacles. This is a respectable establishment, and respectable establishments do not receive anonymous confessions in ink.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh, my goodness, yes, I'll wait, Madame, I'll wait. Sorry. Shall I hold the book steady for you? It's heavier than it looks, and so is my conscience.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Pierce, put the book down before your conscience tips it over. Madame, a note nobody remembers writing is either a ghost or a guest, and I'd rather it were the ghost. Ghosts tip better.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Ghosts or guests, it makes no difference to the ledger. Pierce, read the note, and Vex, kindly stop polishing that glass as though it had insulted you.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Right away, Madame! Sorry. Oh, goodness, I'm holding it so tightly the page might tear. Here it is: "Room 404 is not empty. Please stop leaving the light on for it.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Vex sets the glass down with a sigh. Then it's a guest, Madame, and a rude one, because nobody has been in 404 since the plumbing scandal. Pierce, which one of you has been sneaking up there with a lamp?

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Pierce, you will not go near 404 with a lamp, nor will Vex with a glass. This is a respectable establishment, and we shall investigate the note calmly, in order, with the lights exactly where they belong.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh, goodness, I'm terribly sorry, Madame, but I may have left the lamp on up there once. Welcome! Sorry. Welcome again. Only once, I promise!

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Once is how it starts, Pierce. Before long you'll be leaving a nightcap out for it, and then it'll be asking me for the wine list.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Pierce, you will fetch that lamp back this instant and bring me the key to 404. Vex, pour nothing for anyone until this is settled. This is a respectable establishment, and we investigate in order.
